test_title: PYST 21: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : MLI :: LKH : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : MLI :: LKH : %

Option 1) # = POL, % = IHE → POL : MLI :: LKH : IHE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebffd5e66d386f4aad6d3072d8ecf067f4281fbae83773d34859d40199dd9137.png] 

Option 2) # = FRL, % = QHE → FRL : MLI :: LKH : QHE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5afdb8c2288c5b03d94a737e86ae2e4337b98e8ca1547f0a3c0fa2545ca3518.png] 

Option 3) # = UIL, % = IXC → UIL : MLI :: LKH : IXC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1844cbbe5dfe1f2145285010631f52d47c3d2349fb43041e844c8e1de6a9542.png] 

Option 4) # = FRL, % = QHF → FRL : MLI :: LKH : QHF

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c64afbac05889a5423a2ecfca3ef9914f7a0de185ef9779cb38fb29a9fefa7c.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
